article.title: Legacy does not lapse if one of two joint legatees die before testator.
article.content:
106Legacy does not lapse if one of two joint legatees die before testator.

Section 106  ·  Part VI · Chapter VI  ·  page 40 of the Act
If a legacy is given to two persons jointly, and one of them dies before the testator, the other legatee takes the whole.
Illustration
The legacy is simply to A and B. A dies before the testator. B takes the legacy.
